test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Advanced Full Test - 04
subject: general
question: A policeman chases a thief on a straight road. The policeman catches the thief in 15 minutes if he drives with a speed of 60 km/h and catches the thief in 0.5 hours if he drives with a speed 45 km/h. What should be his driving speed (in km/h) to catch the thief in just 10 minutes?
solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **Time** taken to catch: T₁ : T₂ = 15 : 30 = 1 : 2.

Ratio of **Relative Speed** (Vₚ − Vₜ): R₁ : R₂ = 2 : 1 (inverse ratio).

⇒ (60 − Vₜ) = 2 × (45 − Vₜ) ⇒ 60 − Vₜ = 90 − 2Vₜ ⇒ **Vₜ = 30 km/h**.

Relative speed for 15 min = 60 − 30 = 30 km/h. For 10 min, required relative speed = (30 × 15) ÷ 10 = 45 km/h.

Required Speed of **Policeman** = 45 + 30 = 75 km/h.

**∴ The correct answer is 75 km/h.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Case 1: **Policeman speed** (Vₚ₁) = 60 km/h, Time (T₁) = 15 min = 0.25 hr.

Case 2: **Policeman speed** (Vₚ₂) = 45 km/h, Time (T₂) = 0.5 hr.

**Formula Used:**

Relative Speed (same direction) = Vₚ − Vₜ

Initial Distance (D) = (Vₚ − Vₜ) × Time

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f56bf5ca06ba0bd56d88188c716f9355a741f3c7ded05ca5d16a569db2b11af5.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let Vₜ be the speed of the **thief** and **x** be the initial distance.

⇒ x = (60 − Vₜ) × 0.25 --- (Eq 1)

⇒ x = (45 − Vₜ) × 0.5 --- (Eq 2)

⇒ (60 − Vₜ) × 0.25 = (45 − Vₜ) × 0.5

⇒ 60 − Vₜ = 2(45 − Vₜ) ⇒ 60 − Vₜ = 90 − 2Vₜ

⇒ **Vₜ = 30 km/h**

⇒ Initial distance x = (60 − 30) × 0.25 = 30 × 0.25 = **7.5 km**

⇒ Required time (T₃) = 10 min = 10/60 = 1/6 hr

⇒ 7.5 = (Vₚ₃ − 30) × (1/6)

⇒ 7.5 × 6 = Vₚ₃ − 30 ⇒ 45 = Vₚ₃ − 30

⇒ **Vₚ₃ = 75 km/h**

**∴ The correct answer is 75 km/h.**

**__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed Concept

When two objects move in the same direction, the relative speed is the difference of their speeds: Vᵣₑₗ = V₁ − V₂.

Catching Time Formula

Time to catch = (Initial distance between objects) ÷ (Relative speed of the objects).

Speed-Time Relation

For a constant distance, speed is inversely proportional to time: S₁/S₂ = T₂/T₁.</p
